text:
sam: Quick broadcast for this sprint: we're tightening preflight checks and nudging the canary window. Read and ack.

sam: Summary: add an explicit perf smoke step, require a one-line canary status on flip, and avoid starting schema work within 10h of freeze. Canary window moved to Wed 01:00-05:00 UTC for this cycle.

rina: Ack. Perf smoke = `./scripts/perf_smoke.sh`?

sam: Yes. Run locally or via CI job `ci/release-smoke`. It will emit P50/P95 and an error-rate sample.

felix: We have a tokenizer patch queued. If the patch touches embedding paths, expect longer canary?

sam: Correct. Heavy-token services get a 2x canary length by default unless eng-sre approves shorter. Tag PRs `release:extended-canary` if needed.

eng-sre: We'll watch token rate and KV cache pressure. If heat > baseline + 10% during ramp, we'll pause and roll back if P95 regresses >20%.

ops-bot: smoke pipeline updated for train-1768: added `check:perf-smoke` and `check:canary-status` hooks. :robot_face: 

release-bot: Policy note: reverting gating rules requires written approval from release leads and SRE. See /policies/release-gates.

rina: small ops ask 
can we post a compact canary line so oncall can scan?

sam: Yes. Canary flip format: `canary=<id> | state=up|down | t=MMm | p95=XXXms | err=Y% | heat=Z%`. One line copy-paste.

felix: I'll push tokenizer fix and run perf smoke, PR #5077.

eng-sre: Reminder: emergency opt-out requires `/optout release-gates --reason "emergency" --approver @ops` (audit logged).

sam: Action items: owners run perf smoke + tag PRs, eng-sre monitor heat & P95, release leads approve exceptions in-thread. I'll post a short changelog tomorrow with canary outcomes. Ping @sam or escalate to #eng-oncall if blocked.
